ground_truth.mechanism: checkout/main.go (lines 565-575) makes its own client span for oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, which fails with grpc UNAVAILABLE, status description name resolver error: produced zero addresses. The payment service's own server span never exists anywhere in the trace's process list - checkout cannot resolve payment's address at all, rather than payment rejecting the call. Sibling calls inside prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart (cart, product-catalog, currency) all succeed, isolating the fault to the charge call specifically.

SPM gap: the PaymentService/Charge client span's own otel.status_code=ERROR is not reflected in traces_span_metrics_calls_total (100% STATUS_CODE_UNSET across the fault window), so an SPM-only verifier would miss this fault entirely; only checkout's PlaceOrder server-span error count moved. Locus: checkout, because the failing span and the flag evaluation are in checkout and payment never receives the call.
